title: Surreal Cosmic Eruption
description: A surreal dreamscape merges a dark, barren left side featuring a skeletal alien-like creature crawling near twisted trees under a large moon, with a vibrant, chaotic right side where a massive colorful explosion of paint and clouds erupts from the ocean, surrounded by floating purple bubbles and two small sailboats on turbulent waves. Red architectural arches float in the starry sky above the scene.
prompt: Surreal dreamlike landscape split between two worlds. On the left a dark eerie barren land with twisted dead trees, a large full moon, and a skeletal alien creature crawling on the ground. On the right a turbulent ocean with two small sailboats and a massive explosive wave of colorful paint clouds in purple, blue, orange, red and green bursting upwards. Large purple bubbles float across the center. Red floating architectural arches in a starry night sky connect both sides. Dramatic lighting, painterly style, high detail.
